audit_items.proof_trace: The property holds. For typed transactions (AccessList, EIP1559, Blob, SetCode), the BaseSignatureTxValidator.IsWellFormed method at line 337 enforces `signature.V is 27 or 28`. Since raw RLP y_parity values are offset by VOffset=27 during decoding (BaseTxDecoder.cs:175), only raw values of 0 or 1 become V=27 or V=28 and pass validation. Any other raw y_parity value (2, 3, 255, etc.) results in V≥29 and is rejected with InvalidTxSignature error.
